items.title: Best Portable Chargers 2026: tested and ranked
items.htmlTitle: Best Portable Chargers 2026: tested and ranked
items.snippet: We measured real delivered capacity, sustained output and recharge time on 24 power banks. The Anker 737 leads on output, the INIU 10000 on value.
items.htmlSnippet: We measured real delivered capacity, sustained output and recharge time on 24 power banks. The Anker 737 leads on output, the INIU 10000 on value.

items.title: Anker 737 Power Bank review - 24,000mAh and 140W
items.snippet: Delivered 17,400mAh of usable charge in our test, about 72 percent of rated, which is normal for a 5V measurement.

items.title: Power bank capacity claims - how manufacturers measure
items.htmlTitle: Power bank capacity claims - how manufacturers measure
items.snippet: Rated capacity is at cell voltage of 3.7V. Expect 60-70 percent of the printed figure at the output port after conversion losses.

items.title: USB-C PD 3.1 power banks discussion
items.snippet: 140W requires PD 3.1 EPR on both ends and a 5A e-marked cable. Most cheap built-in cables are not rated for it.

items.title: Best power banks for laptops
items.snippet: Only banks with 100W or higher sustained output can charge a 16 inch laptop while it is in use. Below that you slow the drain, you do not reverse it.

items.title: INIU 45W 10000mAh long term impressions
items.snippet: Two years in, capacity is down maybe 10 percent. For the price it is very hard to argue with, though the shell scratches easily.
